text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, you’ll get a clear sky and a crisp fall feel, with the sun going down at 5:58. Tonight stays mostly clear, and temperatures will settle to around 35 by morning, so bring the heavier jacket if you’ll be out late.

Thursday keeps the dry stretch going, mostly sunny with a high near 55. A north wind will be a little more noticeable at times, and the very dry pattern is raising brush-fire concerns, so be careful with outdoor flames. No rain is expected, making tomorrow another good day for a walk or bike ride, just plan for a chilly start and a cooler afternoon.
